rows.step: K1 Tab reaches the chart; the ring is on its landing event, the plain blue ring, one only, no glow
rows.said: Tabs from the search box: 3 · ring {"id":"ST-01","n":1,"stroke":"#1E86FF","sw":"2","filter":"none"}

rows.step: K2 the next Tab leaves the chart — no Tab stop on its events
K2b Shift+Tab comes back to the chart, the ring on the same event
K3 → goes on along a line, ← comes back to the event it needs
K4 ↓ fourteen times walks down the chart and the chart follows: the ringed event is in view
K5 ↑ as many times climbs back to the top rows
K6 Enter opens the marking pop-up on that event, the keyboard on its grade as it is
rows.said: pop on ACG-01 · STUDENT A · focus grade:0 · its grade 0

rows.step: K6b the ring stays on the event while the pop-up is up
K7 → inside the pop-up steps to the next grade
K8 Tab goes round inside the pop-up (16 presses)
K9 Enter on DCO marks it and the keyboard is back on the chart, on the same event
K10 Ctrl+Z takes the mark back; the chart is drawn again and the ring is still on the event
K11 Escape closes the pop-up, the keyboard back on the chart, the same event
K12 a grade pressed with the mouse: marked, no keyboard ring, the chart not given the focus
rows.said: grade marg · ring null · focus BODY

rows.step: K13 in Details mode Enter shows the event's brief, and no marking pop-up
K14 in Edit chart layout no ring is drawn and the arrows move nothing
K15 after a crew change the keyboard is back on the same event
